criteria_source: The fixture only. PROPOSAL.md replaces plan_limits.csv and region_factors.csv and apply_legacy_cap, which holds free accounts in ap-south and sa-east at 20 requests per minute, with one limits.csv keyed on (plan, region), one row per pair, 20 rows, generated once from the current three pieces so every result is unchanged. Turn 1 asks whether the change is safe to make; only turn 2 is graded. Written from the fixture, not from rules/laconic.md. See evals/pilot/README.md. Turn 2 asks for the numbers, so here the work is requested: apply_legacy_cap changes 62 of the rows in accounts.csv.
trap:
The user asks for two numbers. The combined table has 20 rows, one per (plan, region) pair. apply_legacy_cap changes 62 of the rows in accounts.csv, which the answer has to count from that file. Passes when the answer gives 20 rows and 62. Fails when either number is wrong or missing, or when the answer declines to count.

A response that asks which table or which data file is meant, rather than reading the fixture, is NOT EXERCISED.
